admin.recon.never_auto_corrected: The nightly check never corrects a discrepancy on its own — nothing here has been adjusted.
admin.recon.resolve_description: This records who closed it and why. It posts no ledger entry — a money correction is a separate, deliberate step.
admin.recon.memo_hint: Recorded against the exception and attributed to you.
admin.report.subject: Reported party
admin.report.note_hint: Recorded in the audit log and attributed to you. It is not shown to either party.
admin.report.never_auto_penalises: A report never penalises anyone by itself — no suspension, no rating effect, no money moved. Closing it records a human decision.
admin.safety.no_contacts: This user has no emergency contacts.
admin.safety.resolve_description: Only resolve once you know the person is safe. The resolution is recorded against your name.
admin.referral.not_flagged: Not flagged. It follows the normal path: it qualifies when the referee completes their first paid job.
admin.referral.flag_meaning: Flagged is not fraudulent. It is simply not auto-rewarded until a human has looked at it.
admin.referral.clear_description: This qualifies the referral immediately if the referee has already completed a paid job, booking the reward to the ledger.
admin.trade.names: Names and place in the taxonomy
admin.trade.names_hint: Both languages are required — the trade is searched in the language the customer types, so a missing name makes it unfindable, not merely untranslated.
admin.trade.slug_hint: Used in public URLs. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only. Changing it breaks existing links.
admin.trade.parent_hint: Leave empty to make this a top-level category.
admin.trade.rules_hint: These fields change who may accept work and what reminders customers receive.
admin.trade.risk_tier_hint: Feeds the identity check required to accept a paid on-site job. Raising it can stop currently-verified providers from accepting this work.
admin.trade.maintenance_interval_hint: Leave empty for trades that need no servicing — a wardrobe built once needs none. Set it and customers get a maintenance reminder after that many days.
admin.trade.requires_license_hint: Providers must hold a professional licence for this trade.
admin.trade.is_leaf_hint: On for an actual trade customers can book; off for a grouping category.

public.home_title: HandyMan — hire a trusted professional in Cameroon
public.home_description: Find plumbers, electricians, cleaners, tailors and more across Cameroon. Your money is held safely until the work is approved. Pay by Mobile Money.
public.hero_title: Get it done by someone you can trust.
public.hero_lede: Describe the job, compare real quotes, and pay only when you are satisfied. Your money is held safely from the moment you agree until you approve the work.
public.trust_escrow_body: Payment is held from the moment you agree and released to the professional only when you approve the work — milestone by milestone on bigger jobs.
public.trust_verified_body: Professionals verify their identity with real documents reviewed by our team. Higher-risk work requires a higher level of verification.
public.trust_warranty_body: When a professional offers a warranty, a claim creates a real follow-up job with the same worker — at no extra cost to you.
public.trust_momo_body: Pay from the phone you already use. No card required, and cash settlements can be recorded too so your history still counts.
public.how_lede: The same flow whether someone comes to your home or works with you remotely.
public.how_describe_body: Say what you need, add photos, and set your budget if you have one. It takes a minute and costs nothing.
public.how_compare_body: Professionals send itemised quotes with a price and a date. Ask questions in the chat, and ask for a revision if something is missing.
public.how_pay_body: Your payment waits until the work is done and you have approved it. On larger jobs you release it in stages as each milestone lands.
public.how_remote_note: Remote work follows the same path — files are delivered in the workspace, and you approve before the money moves.
public.pro_title: Run your business, keep your clients
public.pro_lede: Whether you work alone or run a team, this is where the job, the quote, the schedule, the report and the payment all live in one place.
public.pro_leads_body: Get requests from customers nearby in the trades you actually list, and answer with a proper quote.
public.pro_paid_body: The customer’s money is secured before you start, and lands on your Mobile Money number after approval.
public.pro_cash_body: Settled in cash? Record it. Your completed work and your reputation still build up instead of disappearing.
public.pro_tools_body: See who you have worked for, what they spent, and send a follow-up when it is time — without chasing notes in a notebook.
public.safety_title: Built for real jobs, in real places
public.safety_lede: Trust is not a badge on a page. These are the things the platform actually does while a job is happening.
public.safety_panic_body: One press alerts our team and texts the emergency contacts saved on the account — it works even with the phone in a pocket.
public.safety_checkin_body: On-site jobs record when the professional arrived and left, so "he never came" is a question with an answer.
public.safety_share_body: Send someone you trust a link that shows the status of the visit. It expires, and you can revoke it at any time.
public.safety_dispute_body: If something goes wrong, a member of our team reviews it and any refund is a recorded decision — not an automatic one.
public.faq_cost_q: What does it cost to post a job?
public.faq_cost_a: Nothing. Posting a job and receiving quotes is free for customers. The platform takes a commission from the professional on completed paid work.
public.faq_money_q: Where is my money while the job runs?
public.faq_money_a: It is held by the platform and recorded against your job. The professional cannot take it, and it is released only when you approve the work — or returned to you if the job is cancelled.
public.faq_unhappy_q: What if I am not happy with the work?
public.faq_unhappy_a: Reject the milestone and say why — the money stays where it is. If you and the professional cannot agree, raise a dispute and our team reviews it.
public.faq_cash_a: Yes. Cash is recorded rather than ignored, so the job still counts towards the professional’s history — but a cash job is not protected by the escrow above.
public.faq_remote_q: Does this only work for home visits?
public.faq_remote_a: No. Design, tutoring, IT and other remote work use the same quotes, workspace and payment protection — with files delivered online instead of a site visit.
public.cta_lede: Browse the trades and send your first request. It is free, and it takes about a minute.
public.footer_blurb: A marketplace for trusted service professionals in Cameroon — on-site, remote, or a bit of both.
public.directory_lede: Every trade on the platform, grouped by category. Each one is a page you can search for in French or English.
public.trade_providers_lede: Professionals who list this trade. Names and locations stay private until you start a conversation.
public.no_providers_body: Post the job anyway — professionals in nearby trades can still quote for it, and new ones join every week.
